title: Lean Zucchini-Chicken Cornbread Bake
summary: A high-protein, lower-fat skillet-style bake with yellow zucchini, chicken breast, Greek yogurt, whole eggs, and leftover cornbread crisped on top.
sourceNote: Developed with ChatGPT as a lower-fat, high-protein way to use yellow zucchini and leftover cornbread without separating egg whites.

ingredients.note: chopped or shredded; use 4 cups if that is what you have
crumbled; use 3 cups for a lighter bake or 3 3/4 cups to use more leftovers
start with 3/4 tsp if the chicken or broth is salty
optional; use 1/3 cup for lower fat

ingredients.item: cooking spray or a small drizzle of olive oil
ingredients.note: for the skillet, baking dish, and top
optional sauce; use 1 to 2 tbsp to taste

steps.text: Heat the oven to 375°F. Coat a 9x13 baking dish or large oven-safe skillet with cooking spray.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the zucchini with cooking spray or a small drizzle of olive oil and a small pinch of the salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini releases moisture and starts to brown slightly. If liquid pools in the skillet, keep cooking until most of it evaporates.
In a large bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, chicken broth, eggs, Dijon mustard, poultry seasoning, smoked paprika, black pepper, and the remaining salt until smooth.

Add the cooked zucchini, chicken, 2 1/2 to 3 cups of the crumbled cornbread, and the optional cheese to the bowl. Stir gently until everything is evenly coated, saving the remaining cornbread for the topping.
Spread the mixture evenly into the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle the remaining crumbled cornbread over the top and lightly spray the top with cooking spray so it browns and crisps.
Bake until the center is set, the edges are lightly browned, and the top has some color.
For a crispier top, broil for 1 to 2 minutes at the end, watching closely so the cornbread does not burn.
Let the bake rest for 10 minutes before serving so it firms up and scoops cleanly.
If using the optional sauce, stir together the sauce yogurt, hot sauce, Dijon mustard, pickle juice or vinegar, and black pepper to taste. Serve on the side.
